_comment: Upper bounds on the median of perf_scenes.sh runs. A metric over its max fails the gate unless blocking is false (then it only warns; PERF_STRICT=1 makes it block).

idle_cpu_focused_pct._why: box (lavapipe) 4.2-4.8%, CI software GL 7.4-7.8%: warns until the remaining focused repaints are gone

oneline_type_p95_ms._why: 10 MB JSON on one line, soft wrap on (VS Code stays usable here). p95 of 30 keys after 2 warm-up keys. Box ~80 ms, leader's box ~165 ms, a small file ~65 ms on the same software renderer; CI runs ~1.5x slower than the box

oneline_jump_max_ms._why: Ctrl+Home/End across the 10 MB line; box ~90 ms
